#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <iomanip>

long double absolute(long double a)
{
    return a < 0 ? a * -1 : a;
}

int main(){
    int a,b,n;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> n;
    int x,y0,y1;
    long double r = std::numeric_limits<long double>::infinity();
    int ansx=0,ansy=0;
    for(int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
    {
        x = i;
        y1 = (double)(a)/b * i;
        y0 = (double)(a)/b * i+1;
        if(r > absolute((long double)(a)/b-(long double)(y1)/x))
        {
            ansx = y1, ansy = x;
            r = absolute((long double)(a)/b-(long double)(y1)/x);
        }
        if(r > absolute((long double)(a)/b-(long double)(y0)/x))
        {
            ansx = y0, ansy = x;
            r = absolute((long double)(a)/b-(long double)(y0)/x);
        }
    }
    std::cout << std::setprecision(17) << ansx << "/" << ansy << std::endl;
}
